      <title>At least 30 killed as fuel tanker crash ignites large fire on Cairo highway</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/25/people-killed-fuel-tanker-crash-ignites-large-fire-cairo-highway</link>
      <description><p>Blaze on ring road surrounding Egyptian capital injures at least 25 people and leaves cars and motorcycles charred</p><p>A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a huge fire on a highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 30 people, Egyptian authorities said.</p><p>The blaze on the ring road, a key artery that encircles the Egyptian capital, also injured at least 25 people and left more than two dozen cars and motorcycles charred, the public prosecutor’s office said in a statement.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/25/people-killed-fuel-tanker-crash-ignites-large-fire-cairo-highway">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Alain Throo, insurance executive based in London, reportedly gored and later died on hike near Mount Cameroon national park</p><p>A Swiss tourist has been killed and British and American tourists have been injured when a group of hikers encountered a herd of elephants in Cameroon.</p><p>The group of six tourists, four British, one Swiss and one American, accompanied by local guides, were hiking near the village of Bakingili in the south of the Mount Cameroon national park on 19 November, on a path used by elephants to access a nearby lake, when they encountered the herd of about 15 animals, according to media reports.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/25/swiss-tourist-killed-british-americans-injured-elephants-cameroon">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Vice-president says he supports reinstatement of Nvidia CEO after ‘assurances’ from top US officials was ‘under no investigation’</p><p>JD Vance said on Wednesday that <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/24/nvidia-jensen-huang-congress">Jensen Huang</a>, the recently <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/24/donald-trump-nvidia-stock-jensen-huang-stock-market">reinstalled Nvidia CEO</a>, was never under criminal investigation and therefore did not need a pardon after Donald Trump <a href="https://nypost.com/2026/11/24/us-news/trump-leaves-door-open-to-jensen-huang-pardon-and-urges-him-not-to-plead-5th-to-congress-next-week/">said</a> he would be open to offering one to the tech executive.</p><p>The vice-president <a href="https://x.com/cspan/status/2125661517911577003">told reporters</a> he supported Huang being reinstated as Nvidia CEO after receiving “assurances” from the attorney general and other top US officials that Huang was “under no investigation”.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/25/trump-open-to-pardoning-jensen-huang-nvidia">Continue reading...</a></description>
